title: Generated code
description: Handle generated files, snapshots and lockfiles without hand edits.

rules.title: Never hand-edit
rules.text: Never edit generated files by hand. Change the source or the generator and regenerate.

rules.title: Run generators
rules.text: After changing schemas, IDL, config options or routes, run the project generation command and commit the result.

rules.title: Regenerate snapshots
rules.text: Regenerate snapshot files with the test tool update mode, then review the diff. Never hand-edit them.

rules.title: List generated paths
rules.text: List generated paths in the agent file so they are easy to recognize.

rules.title: CI diff check
rules.text: Add a CI check that regeneration produces no diff.

rules.title: No incidental diffs
rules.text: Do not commit incidental changes to generated files that come from unrelated tooling runs.

rules.title: Generated header
rules.text: Mark generated files with a header naming the generator and the command that rebuilds them.

rules.title: Deterministic output
rules.text: Make generators deterministic: stable ordering, no timestamps and no absolute paths.

rules.title: Exclude from tools
rules.text: Exclude generated and vendored directories from formatters and linters in tool config.

rules.title: Lockfiles are generated
rules.text: Treat lockfiles as generated. Change them with the package manager, never by hand.
